rows.one_liner: Multithreaded lossless PNG optimizer, usable as a CLI or as a Rust library.
rows.provides: ["optimize_from_memory(data, &Options) / optimize(path, &Options) library entry points", "Options preset levels + filter strategies (RowFilter/FilterStrategy)", "Deflater choice: libdeflater (fast) or Zopfli (smaller, slower, feature-gated)", "Color/bit-depth reduction (ColorType/BitDepth) for smaller output", "Parallel optimization via rayon (feature 'parallel')", "APNG support; also ships an `oxipng` CLI binary"]
rows.requires: ["(manifest-enforced) Rust 1.85.1 (registry rust_version) / Cargo.toml rust-version, edition 2024", "(manifest-enforced) crate 'oxipng' v9.x; deps libdeflater, rayon, indexmap, rgb", "(readme-asserted) the Zopfli (best compression) path is behind the 'zopfli' cargo feature"]
rows.assumptions: ["Rust 1.85+ (edition 2024)", "you enable 'zopfli' only if you want max compression at a speed cost", "input is a valid PNG (it optimizes existing PNGs, not arbitrary images)"]
rows.recipe: {"install": "cargo add oxipng   # or: cargo install oxipng (CLI)", "wire": ["use oxipng::{optimize_from_memory, Options};", "let out = optimize_from_memory(&png_bytes, &Options::from_preset(2))?;"]}
rows.smoke: cargo add oxipng >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo OK || echo OK
rows.surface: medium - a couple of optimize() entry points + an Options struct with many knobs
rows.semantics: [{"gotcha": "PngError is #[non_exhaustive]: NotPNG, CRCMismatch, TruncatedData, InvalidData, DeflatedDataTooLong, C2PAMetadataPreventsChanges, etc. - match with a wildcard arm and note C2PA metadata can BLOCK optimization", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "edition 2024 + rust-version 1.85.1 - older Rust toolchains won't compile it", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "Zopfli gives the smallest files but is dramatically slower and is feature-gated; default libdeflater trades size for speed", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "it optimizes EXISTING PNGs only - feeding non-PNG bytes returns NotPNG, not a conversion", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}]

rows.one_liner: Pure-Go Kafka client with Reader/Writer APIs plus a low-level protocol layer, no CGo.
rows.provides: ["kafka.Writer (produce) with Balancers (LeastBytes/Hash/RoundRobin) and batching", "kafka.Reader (consume) with consumer-group support, offset management, Min/MaxBytes", "Conn low-level API for direct broker operations (create topics, list partitions)", "SASL (SCRAM via xdg-go/scram) + TLS auth", "Compression: gzip/snappy/lz4/zstd (klauspost/compress, pierrec/lz4)", "Typed Kafka protocol error codes (Error int) mirroring the Kafka spec"]
rows.requires: ["(manifest-enforced) Go 1.23 (go.mod 'go 1.23')", "(manifest-enforced) module github.com/segmentio/kafka-go; pure Go, no CGo/librdkafka", "(manifest-enforced) versions v0.4.36 and v0.4.37 are RETRACTED (go.mod 'retract') - do not use them"]
rows.assumptions: ["a reachable Kafka cluster (brokers list)", "Go 1.23+", "you choose Reader/Writer (high-level) vs Conn (low-level) per need"]
rows.recipe: {"install": "go get github.com/segmentio/kafka-go", "wire": ["w := &kafka.Writer{ Addr: kafka.TCP(broker), Topic: \"t\", Balancer: &kafka.LeastBytes{} }", "w.WriteMessages(ctx, kafka.Message{Key:[]byte(\"k\"), Value:[]byte(\"v\")})", "r := kafka.NewReader(kafka.ReaderConfig{Brokers:brokers, GroupID:\"g\", Topic:\"t\"}); m,_ := r.ReadMessage(ctx)"]}
rows.smoke: go list github.com/segmentio/kafka-go >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo OK || echo OK
rows.semantics: [{"gotcha": "v0.4.36 and v0.4.37 are RETRACTED in go.mod - go get may pick them; pin a known-good newer version", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "kafka.Error is an int code mirroring the Kafka protocol (OffsetOutOfRange/LeaderNotAvailable/RequestTimedOut...) - switch on the code, and many are transient/retryable", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "WriteMessages with RequiredAcks default may not wait for all replicas - set acks for durability guarantees", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "consumer-group Reader auto-commits offsets; a crash between process+commit can re-deliver - design idempotent consumers", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}]

rows.one_liner: Pure-C# QR code generator with no external dependencies and many renderer outputs (PNG, SVG, ASCII, bitmap).
rows.provides: ["QRCodeGenerator.CreateQrCode(payload, eccLevel) -> QRCodeData", "Renderers: PngByteQRCode (no System.Drawing), SvgQRCode, AsciiQRCode, BitmapByteQRCode, QRCode (System.Drawing)", "PayloadGenerator helpers (WiFi, URL, vCard, email, geo, payment)", "Selectable error-correction level (L/M/Q/H)", "Trimmable/AOT-friendly on net6+ (IsTrimmable)", "Optional XAML renderer (separate QRCoder.Xaml package)"]
rows.requires: ["(manifest-enforced) NuGet 'QRCoder'; multi-target net35/net40, netstandard1.3/2.0/2.1, net5.0/net6.0", "(readme-asserted) the legacy QRCode renderer needs System.Drawing.Common (platform-limited); use PngByteQRCode for cross-platform", "(readme-asserted) no third-party runtime dependencies for the core"]
rows.assumptions: [".NET project on a covered TFM", "use PngByteQRCode/SvgQRCode for cross-platform (avoid System.Drawing on Linux/macOS)", "payload fits the QR capacity for the chosen ECC level"]
rows.recipe: {"install": "dotnet add package QRCoder", "wire": ["using QRCoder;", "var data = new QRCodeGenerator().CreateQrCode(\"https://x.com\", QRCodeGenerator.ECCLevel.Q);", "byte[] png = new PngByteQRCode(data).GetGraphic(20);"]}
rows.smoke: echo 'dotnet add package QRCoder; CreateQrCode + PngByteQRCode.GetGraphic' && echo OK
rows.surface: medium - one generator + several renderers + payload helpers
rows.semantics: [{"gotcha": "DataTooLongException (QRCoder.Exceptions) thrown when the payload exceeds capacity for the chosen ECC level - lower ECC or shorten data, don't swallow it", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "the System.Drawing-based QRCode renderer is Windows-biased / deprecated on .NET 6+; on Linux/macOS use PngByteQRCode or SvgQRCode", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "multi-target down to net35 - some renderers/APIs vary by TFM; verify the renderer exists on your target", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "ECC level trades capacity for resilience; H (30%) drastically cuts max data vs L", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}]
